Seriously just play Payday 2, it has more players anyways. Can't believe I wasted $40 on this.

In my opinion, it's better than payday 2. The gunplay feels amazing, sure you could argue that there isn't a great variety of enemies but it's still very fun.

Very Great FPS robbing & cooking Game and has been a lot of update & fix since it launched, the game-play is just same as PD2 but modern version and I really enjoy this game since Day 1 also I know the launch is not good start & ain't too many players with a lot bug on that time but that's normal for the new games like cyberpunk 2077 during the first launch like bug, crash and else. The Music is amazing like all of it are Rock/Metal music feels same as PD2.

A downright disappointment to modern gaming, and a spit in the face to one of the most loyal fan bases imaginable, who supported and kept this mess of a series alive much longer than it ever deserved. Want a good game? Play Payday 2. If you want to waste your time with boring gun-play, unimaginative skill sets when compared to Payday 2, about 8 heists with repetitive objectives, and uninspired mission designs, then play Payday 3 and be miserable.

Payday 2 took a long time to become the game it was, but the potential was always there.
Payday 3 lacks the potential to become anything other than another cash grab.

got game from a friend, played with them, went to a jewelry store, looked at gaurd, pointed at them and said "gaurd" 10000000000 times, looked to my left, blowtorched a jewelry box right in front of the guard and all the civ's, walked away with the jewelry and escaped. 10/10 good game

the actual game itself isnt bad, just lacking content atm (guns, perks, cosmetic masks, etc). the main problem is that the game is purely online only and you can only play by connecting to the games servers with no way to create your own. i would recommend checking the game out in like two or three months unless you are a huge payday head.

Well guys this is it. i has been waiting for this moment since the game came out to write this review. and what we see? a whole month has passed since the release and not a single patch has been released that would fix this piece of **** called PAYDAY 3. these are main problems of the game: first of all optimization, well, what can I say. it seems that the developers do not know such a word, constant fps drops even though my computer is above average. finding a person to play with is also another challenge. you can wait for him for five minutes and still play alone. poor interface, no functions that it would seem should be by default (cutscene skip, crime net, not ready button). to sum it up, I’ll say that it’s better to still play payday 2 than this.
Along way since launch, Still a few bugs but they will no doubt get patched out. Pretty fun for the bare minimum. Obviously not as flashed out as Payday 2 but I look forward to where this goes.

god i hope this game doesn't die
was a little skeptical seeing reviews initially but the progression is locked to challenge XP for unlocks only--perks and weapon XP you can get just from completing missions, plus the challenges themselves seem like they'll take you a pretty long ways just playing however you want (i.e. its a bunch of "kill X enemies with this weapon, clear X mission" objectives that scale so you can just do the same thing over and over and still get infamy levels)
It's a decent game if you never played Payday 2, but if you did, it's basically just new DLCs to the same game but with a few improvements and also a few deprovements.

The game has potential but defiantly needs work. I think the biggest thing right now would be a single player option with bot teammates like in the other game. I would say buy this, but in about a few years or so because its hard to do if its your first game in the payday series, but also its hard to play if you like single player overall. Still, it has potential. And I've had Payday 2 since it came out "on Xbox mainly" so I have experience with how this plays.

played this game on Xbox from launch up till the first update, have all the achievements on there and honestly regret buying it on pc as I feel I'm flogging a dead horse at this point trying to enjoy a game I once loved
just like the devs are trying to resurrect this pos because they just seem to make it worse

all I can say at this point is. Refund 2.0 when?
I CANNOT bear the movement in this game; the engine they use is far worse than Payday 2's in terms of overall feel and doesn't suit the game's playstyle.

I have played a lot of Payday 2. Bought this regardless of the mostly negative reviews. The gameplay is good, no depth on customisation, no depth in how you can spend your money. Limited heists is an issue. The killer so far has been the terrible servers; managed to play 3 games with a friend yesterday and the servers have been down since. To rub salt even further into the wound, you cannot play this game offline in any capacity. Far too often now, games are being released at a hefty price, unfinished and unplayable...
I genuinely enjoy it and the devs are putting alot of work in, which shows, if you have the patients for improvement, I feel like it'll be worth it

One thing PAYDAY 3 and SimCity (2013) have in common: You couldn't play them for the first month after launch.

Jokes aside, PAYDAY 3 has matured a lot over the last 3 years and is now a great co-op experience with fun gameplay and a punchy soundtrack, just like PAYDAY 2. Following what I can only describe as one of Starbreeze's best decisions - opening up all heists to the entire playerbase - it now makes this title a fair deal, even at full retail price.

Looking forward to more heists!

Downloaded it during the free weekend. Really wanted to love this game since I genuinely enjoyed the second one. Unfortunately, within an hour the game crashed and wouldn't let me back in since it couldn't connect to my "Nebula" account. For those reasons, I will not be buying it. But it was fun for the hour I got in!

Payday 3 in this current state is not worth the price. The matchmaking is atrocious, there are numerous bugs and way to little content (8 Heists).
The progression is also stupid, you have to complete challenges to level up in general, which means that you have to go out of your way to do them and you can't just level by playing.
The leveling of guns also takes ages.
The gameplay itself is pretty good, the skill system also got an improvement. It just needs more content and better storytelling
Game need to keep update and make game better. Now i have more fun about gunplay of this game. just keep going update i still wait.

Like god a shotgun has never felt better to use
after the first update is much better cool story but way to short its kinda hard to lvl up after some point still fun with friends

There are still way too many things Starbreeze needs to fix or add into the game but the way they are fleshing out the game and the further plans on the coming updates seems promising and sort of hopeful.
Right as of now it's a good game to buy with all DLC's while on a discount and a pretty fun one too for a good amount of hours, as they make the game more customizable and increase the heists variety, not as in heist count but rather the style, I'm sure it will be even better to play pretty much all the time.

Also still banger music 🔥

Decent, I am having fun.
Some stuff I'd love remade, like taser and melee stuns to not completely take away control because otherwise it becomes a waiting simulator.

After way more hours I can say, that I got hooked. Now all that is left is wait for even more content

This game will take some time to get better, Just wait.

As for right now, no its not worth any of the $

Always online is Always a bad idea.
Can't even set up to play solo without having to connect online is so Stupid.

A decent game that has recovered from a disastrous launch and a fun one when there's no one screaming into your ears how horrible it was or comparing its amount of contents to a ten-year-old game.

What it needs right now is a relaunch because the low player count makes it hard to find matches (at least in my region) and more contents (heists, weapons, skills, non-cosmetic stuff, etc.) so the grognards will have something to do.

Fundamentally unplayable. Have been in queue for a heist in a private lobby with 2 friends for over 20 minutes. Have not been able to get into a single heist yet. Servers for a co-op game make a lot of sense!

First they make the game online only because they wanted to ape off of the Fortnite item shop, then they didn't even implement that shop because hackers found out how to give themselves the unreleased items at launch, and now offline mode has been cancelled. I'm never going to get invested into a game like this if it becomes permanently unavailable.

Despite the horrible server issues on launch, The game is super well made and has a lot of room to grow. The game in its current state is still a blast. People have to keep in mind Payday 2 has had 10 years to craft into the masterpiece it has. We've managed to full stealth all the heists you could do it on and I honestly couldn't be more satisfied with how it plays. The combat feels solid, I think weapon customizing could use a little work but that's about it. Super enjoyable and tons of replayability with the heists. Great with a group of friends, had a ton of great moments. Super excited to see how future heists will be played out!

So after a few YEARS of development we are in a state were this is actually a game worth playing.
IF Payday 2 would not exist this would be a banger. But every minute playing this I just wish I would be playing payday2. The built variety and weapon choice is just above and beyond compared.
I have to admit that the stealth mechanics have been improved a lot and i like that its now perfectly viable to transition from stealth to loud if something goes wrong, but for me, as a loud main thats not enough.

The real heist was the one Starbreeze pulled on our wallets. 48 hours since launch and servers are still crippled. Unacceptable. I enjoy this game, when it works. 7/10

Update:
It's been about a week since launch and server conditions have improved. Hoping for an offline mode to be added in the future.

The gameplay is solid and stealth feels very fun and rewarding. The missions and environments are designed pretty well. Going loud needs some balance, and in my opinion is just not fun. Going loud on very hard / overkill, you basically need a whole squad of experienced players with adequate perks otherwise you are wasting your time.

Lastly, the XP system is garbage. Needing to grind challenges and weapons as your only real way to level infamy was a bad decision and one that I hope changes down the road.

If there was an option to select a "Neutral" recommendation, I would. Game has promise. Needs more content and some QOL changes. However, for payday fans it's enjoyable still.

Played it during the free weekend, I gottta say,, somethings aren't that good. The guns feel a bit too arcade and the prices for attachements and guns is honestly insane. 

BUT, I think it has a lot of potential, idk how it was before but the changes of gameplay from being either full stealth or full loud -> to allowing you to stealth and when things go loud you aren't caught with your pants down is really nice and takes a lot of the frustration of playing stealth.

The fundamental issues of the game is too ingrained, from the need to be connected to a Nebula account even to play offline, a lack of content, and overall feeling of the game is slowly being abandoned with drip feed updates that barely address said issues. Despite the overall negative reactions and press, the game could still manage to find a foothold if given enough content and attention from Starbreeze, but the inevitability of this game being pulled of it's meager life support and left abandoned is becoming more likely every day.

After 10 years of feedback and improvements made to Payday 2, this game has somehow gone backwards by almost 10 years.
The live server issue is only a distraction to the real problems this game has.

They have decided to remove almost all of the functionality and QOL improvements that the community requested and had added to Payday 2.
This game is in every way worse than Payday 2.

it MIGHT be worth playing in 5-6 years time once it reaches the playability of Payday 2 5 years ago.

just play payday 2 they still havent done anything of worth with this one infact they have taken more away than added the guns the joker allies etc. so yea just run payday 2 maybe with a enb if you want it to better looking.

PAYDAY 3 doesn't feel fun to play.

Granted, I didn't play much of this game so take my review with a grain of salt. That being said, on the other hand nothing about this game inspired me to play it more. I think if you had a full team of friends to play with it would probably be a lot more fun. My experience with the game thus far has been with random people and I haven't found much to enjoy about it.
Your servers fucking suck. The decicion to go to a matchmake system based on separate servers instead of peer peer or dedicated was not the best idea.

The launch of the game was shakey at best, but that was also the same with payday 2, overtime it is growing to become great again, also love the fact if you have a buddy who owns the Hiest you can play them as well for free.

review will remain negative until they remove the "stat bars" on weapons and bring back the damage numbers in payday 2.

an absolutely RIDICULOUS step back in transparency and information for the player. i can't think of a logical reason for the step back besides them just being lazy. now i have to google weapon stats. so stupid.

Despite what people say, with new content this game is amazing. The guns feel punchy and realistic and the environment looks amazing. The details and levels of security still surprise me, allthough I only got 24 hours, my only negative is that there isnt much incentive to try out new guns, based on the damage ratings I feel like the setup I have, after only doing a couple hiests, is the best.
Unrelated to my(boring) experience with this game(PD2 is infinitely better), but why does this game have the hentai tag?

bought on release played a bit then and again but now am back into it more and its changed. actually gives more a challenge to stealth now than it did before still a great game to play alone or with friends, starting to remind me of the exact moments in payday 2, not complaining just reliving the moments and enjoying them.

Skills and Armor 2.0 really make this game much better. It gives a lot more variety and build craft that the game desperately needs. Payday is on the right track, and I hope it keeps getting more and more content.

has potential, but I have to say, it might be fun if you have a party to play with or if you just don't mind joining random people. As for me I mostly like to play solo, and this game has a beta solo version apparently since July last year and it still feels a bit weird.
Sorry for the comparison but Crime Boss for instance felt like a good experience even while playing solo and being able to at least order the bots around. As far as I remember even PAYDAY 2 felt better on solo missions
At the end of the day I guess if you have a party to play with maybe it's worth to give a shot, but if you prefer to play solo and are looking for something like this Crime Boss might be a better option
Honestly, pretty fun. Stealth is way easier for smooth brains like me, and feels more call of duty-esque. but music doesn't hit hard unlike payday 2 or payday: the heist.
